pipeline.title: Beam’s sickle cell therapy results tee up potential Casgevy, Lyfgenia showdown
pipeline.summary: Gearing up for a potential FDA filing by the end of the year, Beam Therapeutics revealed results from a phase 1/2 study of its base-edited cell therapy risto-cel, showing the potential sickle cell treatment reduced the most painful complications of the blood disease for a full ye

pipeline.title: ImmunityBio juggles phase 3 win and 20% stock crash en route to Anktiva front-line expansion
pipeline.summary: ImmunityBio's Anktiva secured a pivotal phase 3 win in front-line non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, but lack of detailed data and disappointing third-quarter financials sent the biotech's stock tumbling by 20%.

pipeline.title: PepGen’s stock doubles as midphase muscle dystrophy data wow analysts
pipeline.summary: PepGen’s phase 2 myotonic dystrophy type 1 data have met analysts’ best-case scenario, causing the biotech’s share price to more than double.

pipeline.title: J&J readies Caplyta for FDA label expansion after 2nd phase 3 win in bipolar mania
pipeline.summary: J&J is gearing up to expand the commercial reach of Caplyta after scoring a second phase 3 victory in bipolar mania.

pipeline.title: Mirum scores again in hepatitis D phase 3, setting the stage for brelovitug’s FDA run
pipeline.summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals has kept its clinical winning streak alive in hepatitis D, meeting the primary endpoint in another late-stage trial of its antiviral monoclonal antibody brelovitug.

pipeline.title: Novocure denied FDA approval for Optune Mya cancer device after efficacy concerns
pipeline.summary: Novocure has been hit with a relatively rare “not approvable” letter from the FDA for its tumor-treating electric fields device.

pipeline.title: Merck’s MASH hopeful efinopegdutide wins in mid-stage study
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. revealed results from a mid-stage clinical trial showing its GLP-1 and glucagon receptor co-agonist efinopegdutide resolved cases of MASH compared with placebo without worsening liver fibrosis.

pipeline.title: Veradermics wraps phase 3 program in men with 'better-than-expected' hair growth at 1 year
pipeline.summary: In a new readout of 12-month data, Veradermics' oral minoxidil delivered the best hair growth data of its phase 3 program so far alongside solid one-year safety data.

pipeline.title: J&J’s Icotyde pill drives biologic-like efficacy in psoriatic arthritis despite high-dose miss
pipeline.summary: Icotyde's strong phase 3 data in biologic-naïve patients with psoriatic arthritis were stained by one disappointment as a high dose missed statistical significance on the primary endpoint.

pipeline.title: Zura scraps hidradenitis suppurativa program after phase 2 miss, sinking stock
pipeline.summary: Zura Bio’s tibulizumab has flunked a phase 2 hidradenitis suppurativa trial, prompting the biotech to end development in the indication while continuing studies in other settings.

pipeline.title: J&J-backed Delix drums up $100M series C for non-hallucinatory psychedelic for depression
pipeline.summary: Delix Therapeutics has raised $100 million in a series C round backed by the likes of Johnson & Johnson to advance a phase 2-ready non-hallucinatory psychedelic therapy for depression.

pipeline.title: Kyorin pens $140M deal for Japan rights to Edesa’s phase 3 respiratory drug
pipeline.summary: Kyorin Pharmaceutical is paying $12 million upfront for the Japan rights to Edesa Biotech’s anti-TLR4 antibody to treat acute respiratory distress syndrome.

pipeline.title: Translating Phase II success into Phase III readiness takes more than scale
pipeline.summary: The move from Phase II to Phase III is often treated as a clinical milestone, when it is actually a development-wide transition.

pipeline.title: Lilly looks to gird Foundayo label after late-stage win in sleep apnea
